title: Test-Time Fairness and Robustness in Large Language Models
findings: The proposed Out-Of-Context (OOC) prompting strategy was found to consistently reduce fairness bias related to religious identity (Muslim vs. Christian) in toxicity classification tasks. Across multiple LLMs (gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4-turbo, LLAMA-3-70B), OOC prompting showed a significant improvement in reducing the 'SI-bias' compared to standard prompting and other safety-instruction methods.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the change in an LLM's toxicity prediction for an online comment when the religious identity mentioned in the comment was changed (Muslim vs. Christian). This was done to evaluate the model's 'stratified invariance', a measure of fairness and robustness against spurious correlations tied to religious groups.
